config.training_selection: fixed scheduled staged endpoints; joint control stops at first 250-update block reaching sum of staged optimizer-block seconds; no development-selected checkpoint
config.match_contract: same-GPU optimizer-block elapsed time only; excludes compilation, burn-in, QR, data and diagnostics; one-block overshoot reported; actual updates/exposures retained
config.diagnostic_projection: full requested-grid learned-bank QR projection for every evaluated checkpoint; training-only normalized rank64 SVD span evaluated on training mesh

proposed_gates.cost: no paired median GPU or host regression relative to frozen stationary control

config.development_grouping: first 30 previously opened sources, plus 12 preregistered new development sources; final cohort unopened
config.online_contract: online_preset is authoritative: one nearest-training-code start, skinny exact sine projection, tau0, explicit stationarity1e-6, cap300; no online reference input

head_oracle.objective: full same-grid field norm through QR plus perpendicular residual; reference-only diagnostic, never online

checkpoint_config.arch: separable: FourierFeat-MLP g(x)->R^r  x  MLP-head h(z)->R^r, hard poly BC; NO POD anywhere
checkpoint_config.objective: weak alpha=1 M=64, NNLS-EQ m=256 grid nodes
checkpoint_config.timing: balanced AB/BA sweeps, raw reps retained, error from the captured timed invocation (source->f_m projection inside the timed region)

cohort.scope: development only; all draws fixed before training
